verdict.rationale: Polar is a billing and Merchant of Record platform, and such a product could plausibly offer user-defined scheduled jobs or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only built-in recurring billing behaviors: automatic subscription renewal each period and a fixed dunning retry schedule. These are adjacent platform behaviors, not a capability for users to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. Since there is no direct support, quality is 0 and no gaps are itemized.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
